text:
maria: Quick sync 1: landing copy sprint for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need final hero lines, one-pager benchmarks, webinar gating, and routing. two-week push?
aj: yes. target webinar next Wed 10am PT. pre-launch post 48h before.
noah: I'll produce 3 hero artframes + 2 CTA variants by Fri.
sam: I'll draft benchmark bullets (p95, tokens/sec, $/k) and a one-pager with sample prompts for the demo.
tess: I'll build the webinar page and hubspot form. confirm routing: mode param -> hubspot tag (hosted -> inbound SDR; dedicated/private -> AE + SE).
maria: correct. utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch_v1. gate detailed latency-playbook.pdf on webinar reg.
aj: Hero copy candidates (short):
  Hosted: "Hosted API 1 start small, scale instantly."
  Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity 1 predictable throughput, reserved GPUs."
  Private: "Private deployment 1 data control and enterprise security."
noah: subhead idea: "One API. Three SLAs."
sam: benchmark bullets:
  Hosted: median latency  & cost per 1k tokens, burst handling notes.
  Dedicated: p95 under sustained load, concurrency guarantees, SLA snippet.
  Private: audit logs + KMS/HSM + compliance attestations.
tess: form snippet to set mode: <input type="hidden" name="mode" value="dedicated">
HubSpot pseudo: if(mode=="hosted") tag='inbound_hosted' else if(mode=="dedicated") tag='ae_dedicated' else tag='ae_private'
maria: CTA A/B (two-week test):
  A: "Get started 1 Hosted" / "Reserve Dedicated" / "Request private consult"
  B: "Try Hosted now" / "Talk to sales 1 Dedicated" / "Book private demo"
aj: will draft social + blog copy Mon.
noah: I'll hand off figma frames + accessibility checklist Tue.
sam: one-pager + CSV of benchmark data Thu.
tess: publish page + hubspot workflow Mon morning.
ops-bot: Reminder: marketing deploy window Wed 08:00 PT. assets to /releases/marketing by Tue 18:00 PT.
maria: Dry run Mon EOD. reconvene Wed 09:00 PT for go/no-go. thanks team! :rocket:
